feedback_by_option.fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.
Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag pigilan, maglagay ng bagay sa bibig, magpainom bago lubos na magkamalay, o umasa sa pagpupunas para mapatigil ang kombulsyon.
feedback_by_option.en: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not restrain, put anything in the mouth, give food or drink before full alertness, or rely on wiping with cold water to stop a seizure.

feedback_by_option.fil: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag pigilan, maglagay ng bagay sa bibig, magpainom bago lubos na magkamalay, o umasa sa pagpupunas para mapatigil ang kombulsyon.
feedback_by_option.en: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not restrain, put anything in the mouth, give food or drink before full alertness, or rely on wiping with cold water to stop a seizure.

feedback_by_option.fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
feedback_by_option.en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis.
feedback_by_option.en: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis.
